tagline: Create Todoist tasks from Discord messages without leaving the conversation
metaTitle: Discord + Todoist Integration: Messages to Tasks
metaDescription: Save Discord messages as Todoist tasks with a reaction or slash command. GAIA keeps action items out of chat. See the setup steps.
intro:
Action items surface constantly in Discord conversations — a feature request in the feedback channel, a bug flagged in support, a task someone volunteers for in a thread. Without a way to capture these, they get buried under new messages and forgotten.

GAIA lets anyone on your server create a Todoist task with a simple command or reaction. Tasks are added to the right project with assignee and due date already set, so nothing falls through the cracks and Todoist stays the single source of truth for what needs to get done.

useCases.title: Capture action items from Discord with a reaction
useCases.description: When a team member reacts to a message with a designated emoji, GAIA creates a task from it. The task includes a link back to the original message for full context.

useCases.title: Create tasks via slash command
useCases.description: Team members type a GAIA command in any channel to create a task on the spot. They can specify the project, due date, and assignee without ever leaving Discord.

useCases.title: Route channel-specific messages to Todoist projects
useCases.description: Messages in your bug-report or feature-request channels are automatically converted into tasks in the corresponding project. Triage happens without manual data entry.

useCases.title: Post Todoist task completions back to Discord
useCases.description: When a task is completed, GAIA posts a brief update to the originating channel. The team sees progress in context without checking the task list separately.

howItWorks.step: Connect Discord and Todoist to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA with your Discord server and your Todoist account. Map channels to projects so tasks land in the right place.
Select whether tasks are created by emoji reactions, slash commands, or automatic channel rules. Configure default assignees and due-date conventions for each channel.

howItWorks.step: GAIA captures and tracks tasks automatically
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors for your configured triggers and creates tasks automatically. Completions flow back to the originating channel so the whole team stays informed.

faqs.question: Do Discord members need a Todoist account to create tasks?
faqs.answer: No. Members trigger task creation through GAIA's bot. Only the connected GAIA account needs a valid login for the task app.

faqs.question: Can I assign tasks to specific projects based on the channel?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA's channel-to-project mapping lets you route tasks from different channels into separate projects automatically. You configure the mapping once in GAIA's settings.

faqs.question: Will GAIA create duplicate tasks if the same message is reacted to twice?
faqs.answer: GAIA deduplicates by tracking which messages have already generated tasks. If a task already exists for a message, subsequent reactions are ignored rather than creating a duplicate.
